tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background behind every card; also the dialog's input field fill.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, tiles, buttons, chips, tooltip, dialog, the pressed segment.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Recessed surfaces: the segmented control's track, expanded trace rows, magnitude-bar tracks, skeleton base.

tokens.name: bar-bg
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar, translucent over a saturate(1.4) blur(10px) backdrop so the page scrolls under it.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, values and body copy on page, surface-1 and surface-2 (13:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Ledes, tile labels, dialog body, badge text, chart value labels. 7.5:1 on page in light, 10.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Card subtitles, tile notes, table headers, axis ticks, empty states, footer, the trace field labels. At least 4.5:1 on page, surface-1 and surface-2 in both themes (4.55:1 at worst, light on surface-2).

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and table row dividers. A hairline, never text.

tokens.name: baseline
tokens.usage: The zero line of a chart, one step stronger than grid.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px outline on cards, tiles, buttons, chips, badges, the top bar's bottom edge, tooltip and dialog.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for buttons, chips and trace rows; also the shimmer highlight in skeletons.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: The one data colour: columns, lines, points, magnitude bars, and the logo mark's fill. Charts are single-series; the card title names the series, so there is no legend.

tokens.name: series-1-wash
tokens.usage: Area fill under a line chart.

tokens.name: series-1-soft
tokens.usage: A quiet tint of series-1 for secondary data marks.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Status dot for healthy: the live pulse, OK pills, 'Within normal range' flags. Always beside a word. 3.3:1 on surface-1 in light.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Status dot for blocked, failed or regressed: pills, flags, regressed chart points, the error banner's edge, and error text. 4.6:1 or better as text on page and surface-1 in both themes (lighter in dark). Always paired with a word or ▲ label, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status dot for errors and middling scores, and the pulse while loading. A deeper amber in light so the dot holds 3.1:1 on every surface; 9.5:1 on surface-1 in dark. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interactive colour: links, the eyebrow, primary buttons, the focus ring (2px solid, 2px offset). A step darker than series-1 in light so it reads as 13px text: 4.6:1 or better on page, surface-1 and surface-2; 5.3:1 on page in dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label text on a primary (accent) button: white in light (5.1:1), near-black in dark, where the brighter blue needs dark text (5.4:1). Not for the logo, whose trace line is always white.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop (literal in the source).

styles.name: hero-title
styles.sample: Is your AI getting better or worse?
styles.usage: The one page headline. Fluid in the source: clamp(28px, 4.2vw, 40px).

styles.name: tile-value
styles.usage: The headline number in a summary tile.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the logo in the top bar.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Tracewise records every call an app makes to an AI model.
styles.usage: The paragraph under the hero title, in text-secondary.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mean judge score per evaluated day.
styles.usage: Base size for the whole page (body font: 15px/1.5).

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card heading (h2). Sentence case, names the series the chart shows.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, segmented options, banner text, dialog body, worst-answer rows. Primary buttons and the pressed segment use 600.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Tile labels, card subtitles, chips (500), table cells, freshness status.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: One line above the hero title, in accent.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tile notes, badges, pills, table headers (600), footer.

styles.name: tick
styles.usage: Chart axis ticks and value labels, tabular numerals, in text-muted (ticks) or text-secondary (value labels).

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase field label above a trace's input and output.

styles.name: code
styles.sample: How do I reset my password?

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tile value top margin; badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card-head row gap; label-to-input gap; tile flag top margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a status dot and its word; eyebrow bottom margin; details top margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in the bar, chips, dialog actions; magnitude bar to its number.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top bar vertical padding; card-head bottom margin; table cell horizontal padding (cells are 9px × 10px).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles and toolbar items; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Tile top padding; banner horizontal padding; trace input/output column gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page gutter; tile horizontal padding; gap between cards; section bottom margins.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Card padding (18px 18px 14px).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; hero bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Main content bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-36
tokens.usage: Hero top padding.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles and the dialog (the source's single --radius).

tokens.name: radius-group
tokens.usage: Segmented control track, error banner, chart skeleton.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons, tooltip, text input.

tokens.name: radius-logo
tokens.usage: The logo mark's corner at 32px (the favicon uses 7px).

tokens.name: radius-segment
tokens.usage: An option inside the segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: The data end of a column; the base stays square.

tokens.name: radius-track
tokens.usage: Magnitude bar track and fill (6px tall).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and badges; 50% for status dots.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles in light only; dark relies on surface steps and the border.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: The pressed option of the segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-tooltip
tokens.usage: Chart tooltip, the only floating element.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the bar, main column and footer.

tokens.name: hero-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the hero text block.

tokens.name: dialog-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a dialog (width: 100% minus 32px on phones).

tokens.name: tooltip-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a tooltip.

tokens.name: control-size
tokens.usage: Icon button square; icons inside are 17px.

tokens.name: tile-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tile column in the auto-fit tile grid; tiles are at least 118px tall.

tokens.name: opacity-refreshing
tokens.usage: Charts, tiles and tables while a refresh is in flight (not on first load, which shows skeletons).

tokens.name: opacity-bar-hover
tokens.usage: A column under the pointer or keyboard focus.

tokens.name: z-bar
tokens.usage: The sticky top bar.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: The chart tooltip.
